title: Modern System Design for AI Era
content: System designers consider various aspects including how much data to store, response speed, failure handling, scalability, security requirements, and cost. For AI systems, additional questions arise such as which model to use, whether AI needs memory, access to private data, RAG integration, tool calling, and automatic action performance. Questions also include how to evaluate AI responses and whether a human approval step is necessary. This series will cover concepts like load balancers, caching, databases, queues, microservices, and distributed systems, connecting them with large language models, RAGs, vector databases, AI agents, memory, tool calling, and MCPs.
